title: Loyalty Discount on Rate Lock Commitment Float-Downs
content:
### Float-down loyalty discount (Rate Lock Commitment)

A borrower who has closed a loan with Larkspur before receives a discount on the float-down fee points. The float-down fee points are never below zero and are rounded to three decimal places. The basis is the customer's other **Mortgage Loan File** records: a file in consummated status, and the date it closed.

**Rule.**

- When the customer holds another Larkspur loan file in consummated status whose closing falls within the float-down loyalty window of **60** months before today, the loyalty-window discount of **0.1** points is subtracted.
- When that consummated file closed before the loyalty window, the loyalty discount of **0.05** points is subtracted.
- Otherwise nothing is subtracted.

Months are counted in whole calendar months from the closed date to today. A closing fewer than 60 whole months before today falls within the window.

| Customer's other Larkspur loan file | Closed | Discount (points) |
|---|---|---|
| Consummated | Fewer than 60 months before today | 0.1 |
| Consummated | 60 months or more before today | 0.05 |
| None in consummated status | — | 0 |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical, today 10 March 2026):* a file closed 11 March 2021 has completed 59 whole months, so the discount is 0.1 points. One closed 10 March 2021 has completed 60 months, so the discount is 0.05 points.
